name: LAB-Bench ProtocolQA
protocol: Original LAB-Bench ProtocolQA full 135-item public/private set, zero-shot CoT, no tools, choices permuted, three-run mean accuracy. Precision and selective coverage are excluded.

explanation.en: Accuracy is the fraction of all 135 ProtocolQA questions answered correctly, averaged across three runs; abstention counts as incorrect.
explanation.zh: Accuracy 是 135 道 ProtocolQA 题目的正确比例，对三次运行取平均；abstention 计为错误。

summary.en: LAB-Bench ProtocolQA tests whether models can diagnose and repair errors introduced into real biological laboratory protocols.
summary.zh: LAB-Bench ProtocolQA 测试模型能否发现真实生物实验 protocol 中被引入的错误，并选择正确的修复步骤。

task_format.en: The model reads a modified biological protocol and experimental failure, then selects the corrective action from four choices plus abstention.
task_format.zh: 模型阅读被修改的生物实验 protocol 和实验失败现象，再从四个修复选项及 abstention 中选择答案。
